title: WHEAT, RYE AND RESPECTIVE FLOURS, DURUM WHEAT AND DURUM WHEAT SEMOLINA — DETERMINATION OF THE FALLING NUMBER ACCORDING TO HAGBERG-PERTEN
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 12700) covers WHEAT, RYE AND RESPECTIVE FLOURS, DURUM WHEAT AND DURUM WHEAT SEMOLINA — DETERMINATION OF THE FALLING NUMBER ACCORDING TO HAGBERG-PERTEN. This Indian Standard (First Revision) which is identical with ISO 3093 : 2004 'Wheat, rye and respective flours, durum wheat and durum wheat semolina — Determination of the falling number according to HagbergPerten' issued by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO) was adopted by the Committee and approval of the Food and Agriculture Division Council. This standard was originally published in 1 988. The revision of this standard is being brought out to align it with the latest edition of ISO 3093 : 2004. The text of the ISO Standard has been approved as suitable for publication as an Indian Standard without deviations. Certain terminology and conventions are, however, not identical to those used in Indian Standards.
